note: Regions the ingestion runs over: a name, a bounding box and a word about why. Each is built on its own, with its own capability vector found by probing the sources (scripts/discover_region.py), its own journal under data/regions/<name>/ and its own site under docs/regions/<name>/. Municipal records exist for San Francisco only; every other region builds from OpenStreetMap, Overture, the lidar and the imagery and says so. Add a region here, not in code.
